visual_identity.core_identity: A squat heavy reptilian monster with eight sturdy legs and a fixed predatory stare associated with petrification.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low broad lizardlike body on eight short legs, thick tail, heavy head held forward.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad reptilian head with strong brow, wide jaw, small teeth, and intense forward-facing eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Stocky scaled reptile with exactly eight legs, low belly, and thick tapering tail.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly eight short sturdy reptilian legs arranged as four pairs beneath a low heavy body; no wings or humanoid limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple scales or armored skin plates used sparingly.

accuracy_checks: eight legs are countable or strongly readable

known_failure_modes.symptom: basilisk has four or six legs
known_failure_modes.correction: restore exactly eight short reptilian legs
remove wings and heroic dragon proportions; restore squat low body and thick tail
restore broad lizardlike torso and all eight legs

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium but heavy, low, and broad; its eight-legged spread makes it occupy significant floor space.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Crouched low with head forward and all weight visibly supported by multiple legs.
environment_fit: stone chambers where petrification evidence can read clearly
